why: A 1972 report prints 'Resolved,' on its own line and the quoted motion on the next, ending '-[Mr E. W. Barker].'. The stored row still credits the mover; the parser gives the record no speaker, as the Resolved rule of 18 October 2026 says.

Title:COMMITTEE OF SUPPLY REPORTING PROGRESS (Suspension of Standing Orders)

Column: 871

COMMITTEE OF SUPPLY
REPORTING PROGRESS
(Suspension of Standing Orders)


    Resolved,

    "That progress in the Committee of Supply on the Main Estimates for the financial year 1972-73 today be reported immediately after completion of the discussion on Head 1003, and leave be sought for the Committee of Supply to sit again on Wednesday, 22nd March, 1972.' -[Mr E. W. Barker].
